common.notLegalAdvice: Estimates only — not legal, labor-law or tax advice. Verify severance and Section 14 with your accountant or lawyer.

landing.title: Where is your business losing time and money?
landing.subtitle: A guided diagnosis for businesses with 5–30 employees. Get a prioritized plan with real costs, P&L savings and payback — not a slide deck.
landing.p1b: Freed hours are shown as hours. They become money only when you actually reduce a position or redirect the time to revenue work.
landing.p2b: Sometimes the answer is cancelling a duplicate subscription or changing a workflow. We recommend what fits, not what's trendy.
landing.p3b: Complete the whole diagnosis from a questionnaire. Salary ranges are fine. Uploaded files are deleted right after reading.
landing.p4b: Industry benchmarks pre-fill the hard estimates — you only confirm or adjust.

onboarding.title: Let's start
onboarding.goal: What do you want to find out?
onboarding.goalPlaceholder: e.g. Should I hire another employee or streamline the service department?

onboarding.privacy4: Salary figures are never sent to AI models.

report.title: Diagnostic report

cancel_duplicate.title: Cancel {cancel} — {keep} already covers it
cancel_duplicate.bundle: {keep} already includes {capability}, so the separate {cancel} subscription is a duplicate.
cancel_duplicate.same: {cancel} and {keep} both do {capability}. Keeping one removes a duplicate expense.

reduce_seats.title: Remove {unused} unused {name} seats
reduce_seats.rationale: You pay for {seats} seats but only {active} are in use.

review_low_usage.title: Review the rarely used {name} subscription
review_low_usage.rationale: {name} is reported as rarely used. If nobody depends on it, cancelling removes the full cost.

process_change.rationale: {process} takes about {hours} team hours a month. A workflow change can remove part of it without buying software.

automate.title: Automate {process} with {tool}
automate.rationale: {process} takes about {hours} team hours a month; {tool} typically removes about {pct}% of that work.

hire.avoid_title: Automate before hiring — the new position may not be needed
hire.partial_title: Hire a smaller position (about {pct}% scope) and automate the rest
hire.locked_title: An alternative to the planned hire
hire.rationale: The hire would absorb {needed} h/week. Automation covers about {automatable} h/week. A hire costs about ₪{hireCost}/month (employer cost) versus ₪{toolCost}/month in tools.

booking_windows.title: Fixed booking windows for {process}
booking_windows.step1: Define 2–3 fixed weekly slots for meetings.
booking_windows.step2: Send clients a standard message with the slots instead of phone back-and-forth.

shared_inbox_rules.title: Shared inbox rules for {process}
shared_inbox_rules.step2: Assign one owner per category and agree on response times.

single_source.title: One source of truth to cut {process}
single_source.step1: Map where the same data is typed more than once.
single_source.step2: Pick one system as the master and stop re-typing elsewhere.

templates.title: Templates for {process}
templates.step2: Turn them into fill-in templates in your existing office suite.

standard_kpis.title: A standard report format for {process}
standard_kpis.step2: Use one template every period instead of building from scratch.

faq_macros.title: Saved replies for {process}
faq_macros.step2: Write saved replies and share them with the team.

batch_billing.title: Batch {process} once a week
batch_billing.step2: Prepare all invoices together from one list.

daily_logging.title: Daily 5-minute logging for {process}
daily_logging.step1: Ask the team to log time at the end of each day.
daily_logging.step2: Review weekly instead of reconstructing at month-end.

followup_cadence.title: A fixed follow-up cadence for {process}
followup_cadence.step2: Use a shared list sorted by next follow-up date.

order_form.title: A standard order form for {process}
order_form.step1: Create one structured order form for customers.
order_form.step2: Reject free-text orders that need re-typing.

cycle_counts.title: Cycle counts for {process}
cycle_counts.step1: Count a small part of stock every week.

content_calendar.title: A monthly content calendar for {process}
content_calendar.step1: Plan a month of posts in one session.

quality.fewer_tools: Fewer tools to learn and secure
